name: Hi-Fi TTS: High-Fidelity Multi-Speaker English Speech Synthesis
description: Hi-Fi TTS is a high-fidelity multi-speaker English speech dataset curated by NVIDIA for text-to-speech (TTS) synthesis. It contains 291.6 hours of high-quality speech recorded at 44.1 kHz sampling rate across 10 speakers (6 female, 4 male) reading public domain books from LibriVox, providing pristine acoustic quality and expressive variety.

license.name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International
license.notes: Corpus released under CC BY 4.0 on OpenSLR.

source_references.title: OpenSLR 109: Hi-Fi Multi-Speaker English TTS Dataset

verification.notes: Verified against OpenSLR repository record and Interspeech 2021 paper.

size.notes: High-fidelity 44.1kHz FLAC audio recordings and normalized text transcripts.

provenance.collection_method: Selected from LibriVox audiobooks using automated audio quality filtering and SNR thresholding.
provenance.curation_notes: Audio normalized, silence trimmed, and forced-aligned with text at 44.1 kHz sampling rate.
